description: This file contains utility methods related to Android MIDI, specifically a method to find a MIDI device by manufacturer and product.

classes.name: MidiTools
classes.description: A utility class providing MIDI-related helper functions, such as finding devices by manufacturer and product.

methods.name: findDevice
methods.description: Finds and returns a MIDI device matching the specified manufacturer and product names from the given MidiManager, or null if no match is found.
